source: due2-native: the empty list as a set right operand (decisions/0013 amendment; issue #69)
notes: Authored for due2. ODRL never mentions an empty list or set as a right operand, and odrl22-shape.ttl accepts () as the IRI rdf:nil, so the policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and the rejection is due2's own (decisions/0013 amendment). Read as the empty set, the permission would never apply and the prohibition would apply to every request.

expected_rejection.why: ex:readInRegion's isAnyOf and ex:noReadOutsideRegion's isNoneOf each take the empty list (), which has no reading. due2-profiles.md §4 rejects it with MalformedConstraint, in stage 2.
